data.title: 牧之原翔子 · 海堤长椅的柠檬汽水
data.description: 【七里滨海堤·午后】翔子穿着浅蓝泳装外搭白色衬衫，坐在海堤长椅上把柠檬汽水递给镜头；她的长发被风吹向一侧，远处冲浪板与海鸟让这段休息显得明亮而安静。
data.action: 海堤长椅上递出柠檬汽水，长发被海风吹向一侧，安静看着明亮海岸
data.lighting: bright afternoon haze over the horizon
data.mood: 把海边的安心递到镜头前
data.promptProse: Shouko Makinohara from Rascal Does Not Dream of Bunny Girl Senpai wears a pale blue swimsuit with a loose white shirt, canvas tote and a lemon soda. She sits on the seawall bench with a lemon soda beaded by condensation. She offers it toward the viewer before taking a sip herself, her dark hair swept sideways by the breeze while boards and seabirds animate the bright horizon. bright afternoon haze over the horizon.
